name: GD Control
description: A Geometry Dash mod menu with a draggable floating button, No-Clip and Speedhack.

noclip-enabled.name: No-Clip
noclip-enabled.description: Suppresses normal player deaths for both players. Anticheat spikes and level completion still use the original game logic.

speed-multiplier.name: Speedhack
speed-multiplier.description: Multiplies the frame delta passed to the Cocos scheduler.
